recommendation: Keep the source fix. It closes the remaining current-build computable metadata gap for FHIR-32817 without changing the already-correct Consent StructureDefinition and narrative. Broader cleanup of unrelated stale Consent ModelInfo fields should be tracked separately.
issue_request: FHIR-32817 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Consent. It requested an explicit, unambiguous computable default decision and resolved by replacing the old Consent.policy/Consent.policyRule shape with regulatoryBasis, policyBasis, and policyText to separate regulatory/indexing context from computable policy enforcement.
initial_application: Commit 7ec3c37642c57792ee12bc07696299ddcc974dd4 initially added Consent.regulatoryBasis, Consent.policyBasis, and Consent.policyText to the Consent StructureDefinition. Later FHIR-39597 work moved the base permit/deny decision to Consent.decision. The active Consent StructureDefinition and narrative already reflected those decisions, but the active FHIR ModelInfo Library still exposed stale Consent.policy, Consent.policyRule, and Consent.Provision.type metadata.
additional_context: Consent and Library are active build resources, and source/library/list-Library-examples.xml includes Library/library-fhir-model-definition as the FHIR Model Definition example. FHIR-45450 later corrected policyBasis.url to policyBasis.uri and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-43331 and a Zulip discussion support the interpretation that regulatoryBasis is non-computable while computable policy uses policyBasis/provision plus Consent.decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so the Consent model metadata defines Consent.PolicyBasis with reference and uri, exposes regulatoryBasis, policyBasis, policyText, and decision on Consent, represents Consent.provision as a list, and removes stale Consent.policy, Consent.policyRule, and Consent.Provision.type entries.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: replaced the stale Consent.Policy model type with Consent.PolicyBasis containing reference and uri.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: replaced Consent.policy and Consent.policyRule entries with regulatoryBasis, policyBasis, policyText, and Consent.decision.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: removed Consent.Provision.type and made provision metadata list-valued with current documentType, resourceType, and expression children.

related_jiras.note: Removed provision zero and moved Consent.provision.type to Consent.decision, which is the current form of the explicit default decision.
Changed Consent.policyBasis.url back to Consent.policyBasis.uri; already represented on the combined branch and reflected in this model metadata fix.
Resolved No Change question confirming regulatoryBasis is non-computable and computable decisions use policyBasis/provision plus Consent.decision.
